productLossClosed: Sidebar V2 no longer hides a renderer-supplied thread action control when settlement and snooze capabilities are unavailable.
Lynx drives action visibility from real row hover state because its compatibility pass removes the Web group-hover selector.

Untouched canonical New thread shells expose a direct Delete empty thread action; threads with any renamed title, user message, turn, session, approval, user input, or proposed plan retain the normal action menu and delete confirmation.
Repeated New thread actions still reuse one local draft and do not append canonical or persisted thread identities before first send.
rootCause: The user-visible process loaded an August 20 bundle with SHA-256 7d7eab5721af0aca1a0991cc4a36461949e6a02e71e90013eb7e9c6eca1ee0, predating the August 22 lazy-draft implementation.
Seven of its eight active projection rows had title New thread, zero messages, zero turns, no session, and no pending state.

The current shared Sidebar row rendered its action slot only when settlement or snooze was supported, even though the Lynx host supplied a general ellipsis action. That made historical empty shells effectively unremovable.
harnessLoss: Three rejected diagnostic runs proved that the existing nested action-menu Delete confirmation is not a reliable Native touch target. The accepted flow uses a dedicated direct-delete control only for conservatively identified empty shells.
A renamed zero-content fixture was rejected for cleanup verification because its shells did not satisfy the safe New thread predicate.
intentionalPlatformDelta: Web keeps its CSS group-hover action disclosure. Lynx uses the same shared row surface with explicit mouse-enter and mouse-leave state because unsupported group-hover selectors are removed during Lynx CSS generation.
classification.evidenceBoundary: The retained Native run used a read-only VACUUM snapshot of the isolated user-visible test state. The verifier copied that snapshot again, mutated only its disposable copy, stopped only its owned process, and left the source process and eight source rows unchanged.

validation.productionBuild: pass with existing Effect import.meta and unsupported CSS warnings
